Maya L (CS): FYI — BrightPath renewal in 9 days. They asked for a plain-language 2-sentence SLO recap for the past 90d, including whether any credits apply and a one-line cause for any latency incidents. Who can own the numbers + wording?
Noah B (Ops): I can pull numbers and calculate credits. Propose 24h freeze before the customer email.
Tanya R (Customer): Please keep it short. They don't want raw metrics, just a simple sentence and a tiny transparency note if a credit is due.
Cal (Eng): There was a short degradation on 2026-03-22 caused by a misrouted traffic rule during a canary — p95 spiked ~45m while we rolled back. Fix deployed same day.
sla-bot: Snapshot: https://dash.internal/brightpath/90d (snap-20260325-0730).
Noah B (Ops): Pre-freeze numbers: uptime=99.889% (90d), p50=120ms, p95=600ms. Under our credit bands that's in the [99.85%,99.9%) bucket => eligible for 0.5% credit of one month committed usage. Will confirm counts.
Maya L (CS): Draft language suggestion: "Over the last 90 days Redwood delivered 99.89% uptime. Per the contract this places BrightPath in the credit tier resulting in a one-time credit equal to 0.5% of one month's committed usage. We observed a short latency spike on 2026-03-22 due to a canary routing issue which was reverted the same day." Keep it customer-facing.
Tanya R (Customer): That's clear. Please include a tiny table for transparency with numerator/denominator and the tiers.
Noah B (Ops): Will add exact counts and the formula. Freeze deadline 2026-03-26 09:00 PT.
Maya L (CS): Thanks — I'll draft the email and slide and loop you both for sign-off. If all good, target send morning of renewal meeting. :white_check_mark:
